title: The Goal in Pictures
kicker: From plain words to the release at run time, in both dialects
html:
The Goal in Pictures

Release a pull request to Dev once it can be merged and its build passes its smoke test.

the goal, whole

Walked once with Claude, kept as a script, and released with no model, in both of HEART's dialects: HAL Schema Forms, and HAL-FORMS.

HAL Schema Forms4 of 5 promoted, 0 model calls per release
HAL-FORMS4 of 5 promoted, 0 model calls per release
504 stoppedby its smoke test, in both, as it should be
say: Remember the release goal: release a pull request to Dev once it can be merged and its build passes its smoke test. Eight lines of plain words. We walked it once with Claude and kept it as a script, in HAL Schema Forms. Today the same goal again, but every party answers in HAL-FORMS, the on-ramp dialect, _templates only. Walked once more with Claude, kept by the generator alone, and released five times with no model. Same outcome. Today I want you to see it: where it runs, what each line becomes, and the path it takes through the web.
